cited_by.title: Men's afro hair: waves, fades, durags and the nape

record.population: Review of acne keloidalis nuchae (folliculitis keloidalis nuchae)
record.finding: AKN is a chronic scarring folliculitis seen mostly in men of African descent after puberty and is classed as a primary scarring alopecia. The cause is unknown; suggested inciting factors include androgens, inflammation, infection, trauma, genetics and ingrowing hairs.
